name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
September 13, 2011
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Frank Harper, Kiwanis Club of Vista
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation declaring the month of September 2011, "National Preparedness Month" in the City of Vista.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C3.
Treasurer's Cash Report for the Month Ending July 31, 2011 (CC)
C4.
Update to Taxicab Insurance Requirements (CC)
C5.
Maryland Drive Street Improvements Phase II (CIP No. 8030) (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2011- , awarding a contract to Dick Miller, Inc. for construction of the Maryland Drive Street Improvement Project Phase II.
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2011- , demanding installation or construction of certain public improvements on Maryland Drive.
3.
City Council Resolution No. 2011- , approving a request for a time extension on the Safe Routes to School Grant for the Maryland Drive Street Improvement Project Phase II.
C6.
River Parkways Grant (CC)
C7.
2010-2011 Community Development Block Grant Consolidated Annual Performance and Evaluation Report (CAPER) (CC)
C8.
2011 Justice Assistance Grant (CC)
C9.
Oil Payment Program (OPP) Application (CC)
C10.
Trade Tech High School Special Event Banner and Sign (CC)
C11.
Agua Hedionda Sewer Lift Station and Vista/Carlsbad Interceptor Sewer, Reaches VC11B-VC15 (CIP No. 8125) (CC)
C12.
South Santa Fe Avenue Drainage Project (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , approving a Fourth Amendment to the Agreement with Tory R. Walker Engineering, Inc. for the South Santa Fe Drainage project.
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , amending the Capital Improvement Program Budget for the FY 2011/12.
C13.
Third Amendment to Property Lease for 127 Main Street (CDC)
1.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2011- , authorizing the Chairperson to execute a Third Amendment to the Lease Agreement with the Vista Chamber of Commerce for the property at 127 Main Street, and authorizing the Executive Director to execute any and all documents and take any necessary actions to implement the Third Amendment.
2.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2011- , amending the Operating Program Budget for FY 2011/12.
DISCUSSION
D1.
City Council Policy 400-01, Naming of Parks, Naming of the Brengle Terrace Recreation Center (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2011- , amending City Council Policy 400-01, Naming of City Parks; and
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2011- , naming the Brengle Terrace Recreation Center for Jim Porter.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
